Dream 2026-11-22 suggests a refinement: sharpen.

**What the vignettes add.** The loss happens at handoff points ("Every pr and wait ends up being a point where a session gets forgotten and the work abandoned"), and the owner wants a whole unit of work marked in progress and driven to finish ("We need to have a holon of work clearly marked as in progress so that it gets driven to finish"; "Once we begin, we need to make sure that the whole unit is completed"). Success test: dogfood "until we know work is not lost when it follows the defined process and any new agent knows how to find the process".

**Proposed.** Every PR and wait is a point where a session is forgotten and the work abandoned, because nothing marks the whole unit of work as in progress and drives it to finish.

**Depth.** Five vignettes, three retellings; recurring and strongly stated. Dates not checked.

If you agree, the change is made by succession: a successor that supersedes this record, which stays as it is.
